title: Still Kicking — EN/KO/HI (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar Korean Hindi language learning warm baritone 104bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual resilience true story Australian family
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Coward punch. November 2021.
Neck surgery. Silver Chain. Back on his feet.
Still kicking. The answer was always yes.

[Verse 2 - Korean, with English translations]
비겁한 주먹. 2021년 11월. (Coward punch. November 2021.)
목 수술. Silver Chain. 다시 일어섰다. (Neck surgery. Silver Chain. Back on his feet.)
아직도 싸우고 있다. 대답은 항상 예스였다. (Still kicking. The answer was always yes.)
그는 심리학자를 만나러 갔다. (He went to see a psychologist.)
그것을 문자 메시지로 말했다. (He said that in a text.)
그의 형제에게. (To his brother.)
그럴 수 있는 남자는 (A man who can do that)
비겁한 주먹에 지지 않는다. (Is not beaten by a coward punch.)

[Chorus - Hindi, with English translations]
अभी भी लड़ रहा हूँ (Still kicking)
उसने जवाब दिया जब उन्होंने पूछा (He answered that when they asked)
अभी भी लड़ रहा हूँ (Still kicking)
ब्राजील से, कोरी ने फोन किया (From Brazil, Corey called)
अभी भी लड़ रहा हूँ (Still kicking)
जोएल लाइन के दूसरे छोर पर (Joel on the other end of the line)
अभी भी लड़ रहा हूँ (Still kicking)
जोएल आरोन मैकआईवर (Joel Aaron McIvor)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Kerry is cancer free. The family went on.
Korean: 케리는 암에서 자유롭다. 가족은 계속 나아갔다. (Kerry is cancer free. The family went on.)
Hindi: केरी कैंसर मुक्त है। परिवार आगे बढ़ा। (Kerry is cancer free. The family went on.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Still kicking — yes
Korean: 아직도 싸우고 있다 — 예 (Still kicking — yes)
Hindi: अभी भी लड़ रहा हूँ — हाँ (Still kicking — yes)
